verdict.rationale: ZCode's marketing says tasks can be triggered remotely via WeChat, Feishu, or Telegram. That is the same kind of chat-based task kickoff, but none of these are the platforms the story names, and the claim comes only from marketing copy. missing for 10: GitHub integration (issue/PR triggers), GitLab integration, Linear integration, Slack integration, detailed docs on the remote-invocation flow, independent or hands-on corroboration.
